policy.scope: NFR-CMP-0001: desktop Chrome/Edge/Firefox current stable and previous stable major version. No native mobile apps, no screen-reader matrix.
policy.registration: Every entry must record version, install source, isolated profile dir, executable path and auto-update policy before execution. Entries are filled during Env-W preparation; null fields mean not yet registered.
policy.autoUpdate: Per-browser field. System installs without a policy-enforced updater freeze register autoUpdateDisabled=false and rely on version checks before and after each matrix round: any version drift voids that round. Isolated installs (unpacked archives) register true.
policy.isolation: Each browser uses its own persistent profile directory under artifacts/m6-acceptance/browser-profiles/<id> (untracked) so evidence cannot leak session state between entries.
policy.axe: axe-core is auxiliary only; keyboard, focus, layout and contrast are judged per NFR-CMP-0001 by Playwright assertions plus manual inspection.
policy.fallback: A combination Playwright cannot drive is executed by the manual procedure in e2e/README.md §Manual fallback and registered with its evidence.
policy.executionStatus: Per-entry three-state marker, definitions in e2e/README.md §登记三态: procedure-written = written procedure only, no executed verification on the entry's execution line; drivability-verified = Playwright drivability actually tested on this entry (drivable + verifiedAt recorded); formal-execution-pending = matrix-level waiting state held in policy, because the AT-0017 formal round has not run for any slot as of 2026-09-21. A written procedure is not drivability verification; drivability verification is not formal matrix execution.
policy.w2Pending: Registered as W2 pending items, none executed as of 2026-09-21: (1) real-browser installation for edge-previous (enterprise offline MSI for 146.0.3856.109; official-package availability still 待核实) and for the official previous-stable Firefox release (155.0.1 from archive.mozilla.org); (2) the formal AT-0017 matrix round over all six slots with per-slot evidence.
